controls.label: Car
controls.hint: Two light four-wheel-drive rally cars, a heavy rear-drive muscle car, or a tall soft pickup. Same simulation, different numbers.

controls.label: View
controls.hint: Behind the car, or from the driver's seat. V swaps them while you drive.

controls.label: Assists
controls.hint: ABS, traction control and steering help. Off, full lock is full lock and the brakes will lock.

controls.label: Grip
controls.hint: How much all the tyres hold, on every surface. 1 is real tyres.

controls.label: Suspension
controls.hint: How stiff the springs are. Low and the body leans and dives; high and it stays flat.

controls.label: Slow motion
controls.hint: Slows the whole world down, the car with it. 0 is full speed; 0.9 is a tenth of it.

controls.label: Power
controls.hint: The engine, as a share of what this car has.

controls.label: Front drive
controls.hint: How much drive goes to the front: 0 is rear drive, 1 front drive. Below 0, what this car has.

controls.label: Steering lock
controls.hint: How far the front wheels can turn, as a share of what this car has.

controls.label: Seconds on its roof
controls.hint: How long it lies on its roof or side before it rights itself.

triggers.label: Reset
triggers.hint: Back to the start: every control, the car, the crates, the mannequins and the view.
